title: Nevers to Pisany, 8 Sept and 14 Oct 1593, BnF fr. 3985 f. 209 and fr. 3986 f. 168, in Nevers cipher no. 46 (catalogue item 21, part)

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3985 no. 116, f. 209 (Gallica btv1b90606498 canvas 419)

transcription.notes: NOTES give 122 tokens; the measured 123 includes the clear word [de]. Copy, not original.

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3986 no. 81, f. 168 (Gallica btv1b9060631k canvas 332)

transcription.notes: NOTES give 269 tokens; measured 272. 1/7, 0/8, 3/5 confusions in the copyist's hand leave stretches garbled.

system.summary: Nevers cipher no. 46: a two-digit alphabet with homophones and nulls, and barred, plain and double-dotted figure series for words and names.

diacritics.note: Bar over a figure selects the word series, two dots the names series.

system.sibling_key: Nevers no. 45 (single-digit null convention) and Gondi to Pisany 22 Sept 1593 with the office decipherment (conventions check).
system.notes: Split 14 Oct 2026: the Revol letters, in the Court symbol cipher no. 60, are targets/revol1593/.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo (cryptiana) read passage 1 of f. 209 and line 1 of f. 168

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Gallica full-resolution canvases of fr. 3985, 3986, 3995 fetched; items mapped to folios.
Key no. 46 transcribed from fr. 3995 f. 87 at full resolution.
Alphabet checked on Gondi's 22 Sept letter with the office decipherment.
8 Sept letter to Pisany read whole.
14 Oct letter to Pisany read in long stretches; garbled stretches left.
Revol letters found to be in the Court key no. 60, not no. 46; the 27 Aug copy is in clear.

Entry split under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): the Revol letters in key no. 60 moved to targets/revol1593/ with key60.txt, decode60.py, atlas60.md, the f. 146v/157v transcriptions and f88/. Coverage re-counted on the two Pisany letters from decode_f209.txt and decode_f168.txt: 390 of 391 figure groups resolve in key no. 46.

outcome.method_basis: The Pisany letters were deciphered with Tomokiyo's Nevers cipher no. 46, transcribed here at full resolution from BnF fr. 3995 f. 87 and checked on Gondi's 22 Sept 1593 letter with its office decipherment: f. 209 in full, f. 168 in long stretches.
outcome.fraction_read_source: decode_f209.txt (122 of 122 figure groups resolve) and decode_f168.txt (268 of 269): 390/391 groups given a value by key no. 46. This counts values, not sense: f. 168 still has garbled stretches in lines 2-8 where the copy's figures are misread.
outcome.notes: f. 209 reads continuously; f. 168 reads in long stretches with garbled passages (figure-reading problems on a microfilm copy). Split 14 Oct 2026: the Revol letters in key no. 60 are targets/revol1593/.

gaps.item: fr. 3986 f. 168, Pisany 14 Oct, garbled stretches of lines 2-8
gaps.detail: microfilm copy, 1/7, 0/8, 3/5 confusable; segscore.py did not resolve them
